headings.text: Some days the island is friendly

crops.alt: Three round wooden boats lie moored along a stone quay beneath a low grey sky, with black rocks across the water behind them.
A long flight of steps climbs between street lamps towards a glass tower under a hard blue sky.
A weathered green timber shopfront with faded signboards is wedged between two much larger modern buildings.
A busy shopping street under paper lanterns and hanging decorations, a young woman walking towards the camera through the crowd.
A weathered hand reaches out past a ship’s rail, holding something small above moving water.
A flag flies from the bow of a ferry over open grey water, a low headland on the horizon.
A man stands sculling a round wooden tub boat across flat water with a single oar, a passenger in an orange life jacket sitting in front of him.
A purple cloth curtain printed with a sailing-ship emblem hangs across the entrance of a weathered timber building.
The timber prow of a wooden boat, roped and cleated, seen close and from below inside a shed.
Heavy dark cloud presses down over a flat sea and low rock outcrops.
In black and white, a stone lantern and two benches stand on a concrete platform at the water’s edge as waves break behind them.
In black and white, a straight seawall path runs to a single shuttered building beneath a heavy sky.
A road bicycle leans against the railing of a coastal path below a steep wooded slope.
A steep green headland rises straight out of the sea beside a pale shingle beach.
The tiled roofs of a small village stand stacked above a dark sea horizon.
Rows of small weathered stone figures stand crowded together in low light.
A teal sea runs out towards a distant range of snow-covered mountains.
Three people stand on a green hillside above the sea with their arms raised, two of them in wide sun hats.
Three drummers in blue happi coats sit at barrel drums in a meadow of orange lilies, a large drum standing behind them.
A dancer in a wide straw hat and dark robe turns mid-step in a field of orange lilies.
A brick church with a tall spire stands against an orange evening sky.
In black and white, the tiered roofs of a castle keep rise against heavy cloud.
A temple hall with a heavy tiled roof stands among trees under a blue sky.
A long tatami corridor runs between sliding doors towards daylight at the far end.
A small carved household shrine stands in a dim corner with fresh flowers set in front of it.
A long low table, worn sofas, a wall clock and a paper calendar in a plain tatami room with a bright window.
A gilded altar stands at the end of a dim tatami hall, a mat and low stands laid out in front of it.
A narrow city lane covered in spray paint, a bicycle parked against the wall in warm low light.
A dense evening crowd under a covered shopping street, one person holding a phone up above the heads.
